snippet.title: Bluey x Crossy Road Castle - Official Launch Trailer | 21 May - 21 July
snippet.description:
Try the obstacle course at Bluey and Bingo’s house in Crossy Road Castle! Collect classic Bluey characters and bring your friends and family to the fun.

⭐ "Bluey's House" is a new tower with brand new Bluey themed levels!
⭐ Collect your favourite Bluey characters!
⭐ Unlock new hats and stickers!
⭐ Pop balloons, avoid gnomes, ride water slides - play the obstacle course challenges and don't get out!
⭐ It's multiplayer - so grab your friends and family and play together!
⭐ Every two weeks new Bluey characters are added to the game to unlock!

Available for a limited time only on Apple Arcade! 

🕹 Try it free: https://apple.co/4dvESfX
